prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "på liknande sätt". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "similarly".
Scene: Two adult learners at separate desks build matching arch shapes from blocks using same sequence, actions clear, no extra text.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "på liknande sätt = similarly; using an alike approach.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "De löser uppgiften på liknande sätt.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
